scheme_name: Subsidy to Purchase E-Bike for Journalists
other_conditions: The applicant's sole livelihood must be through journalistic activities
Must be working for a media organisation
Resident of Goa for at least 15 years
Full‑time working journalist for at least eight years
Should not have previously availed any government subsidy for purchasing an e‑bike
benefits_summary: Up to 50% subsidy on e‑bike purchase, capped at ₹50,000, paid in a single installment upon submission of purchase documents.
